title: Payment Acceptance Limits and Cash Application Hold Periods (Commercial Credit Account)
content:
**Cash application standard.** A Commercial Credit Account accepts payments within these tier limits.

| | Net 10 Starter | Net 30 Standard | Net 30 Preferred | Net 45 Business | Net 60 Corporate | Net 90 Strategic |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Largest single commercial card payment, USD | 2500.00 | 5000.00 | 10000.00 | 25000.00 | 25000.00 | 25000.00 |
| Card convenience fee, percent of the card payment amount | 2.5 | 2.5 | 2.5 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Order applied to a payment without remittance detail | oldest due date first | oldest due date first | oldest due date first | oldest due date first | oldest due date first | oldest due date first |
| Business days a payment without remittance detail is held unapplied | 3 | 3 | 5 | 5 | 10 | 10 |

- **Card limit** — the largest single payment accepted by commercial card.
- **Card convenience fee** — percent of the card payment amount.
- **Application order** — how a payment received without remittance detail is applied across open invoices; every tier applies oldest due date first.
- **Unapplied hold** — business days a payment without remittance detail is held unapplied awaiting remittance before the default application order is used.

*Hypothetical:* a card payment of 1000.00 on a tier with a 2.5 percent fee carries a convenience fee of 25.00.
